model: two thermal nodes per pixel: mushroom Ta absorber and directly Si-connected TES, linearized around the voltage-biased operating point

direct_TP_mass_model_deposit.reason: TP_L... is an unresolved Ta/TES pixel proxy; direct gamma/electron deposition is conservatively assigned to the bulk Ta absorber

G4CMP_Si_phonon_sensor_energy.rule: ballistic interception proportional to the user-specified absorber-post versus direct-TES Si contact perimeter

input_partition.interface_transfer: instantaneous source after G4CMP surface absorption; no additional interface time constant or bottleneck

linear_response.purpose: compare optimal-filter pulse templates below saturation without reintroducing the nonlinear one-node artifact
linear_response.noise_weighting: none; the reported residual is an unweighted time-domain L2 shape difference, not a detection significance

scope.candidate_C_input: five-run mean tuned-C G4CMP sensor arrival stream plus direct TP deposits
